implemented_requirements.requirement: Read a text file supplied by the user
implemented_requirements.evidence: file_handler.read_text_file validates the path and returns the file content; main.run_detection calls it with the input file argument.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect palindromic words, phrases, and whole lines
implemented_requirements.evidence: palindrome_detector.PalindromeDetector implements is_palindrome, find_palindrome_words, find_palindrome_phrases, find_palindrome_lines and aggregates them in detect().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide a human‑readable report of the findings
implemented_requirements.evidence: report_generator.generate_report formats words, phrases, lines and statistics; display_report prints it; main prints the report and optionally writes it to a file.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Command‑line interface with options (input file, output file, min length, case sensitivity, punctuation handling, etc.)
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.parse_arguments defines arguments – input_file, -o/--output, -m/--min-length, --case-sensitive, --keep-punctuation, --max-phrase-words, --encoding – and passes them to the detector.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Write the report to an optional output file
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.run_detection returns a report string; if args.output is provided, write_results_to_file writes the report to the given path.

judge.summary: The submitted source provides a complete, runnable Python program that reads a text file, detects palindromic words, multi‑word phrases, and whole lines, and produces a formatted report. All core functionalities are implemented with concrete code, and the command‑line interface matches the specification. No show‑stopper bugs are evident, so the solution passes the acceptance criteria.
